meals.title: Protein Pasta with Rotisserie Chicken & Marinara
meals.note: Make extra pasta tonight — you'll use the leftovers to build Tuesday's cold pasta salad.
steps: Boil pasta per package. Reserve a splash of pasta water before draining.
Shred the rotisserie chicken — pull off as much as you'll need for tonight plus Tuesday's salad.
Warm marinara in a pan over medium heat. Toss in spinach and stir until wilted, ~2 min.
Add drained pasta and a splash of pasta water. Toss to coat.
Plate the pasta, top generously with shredded chicken.
Season and serve. Easy as that.

meals.title: Prep Day: Build the Cold Pasta Salad
meals.note: Make this once and you have grab-and-go lunches or dinners for the rest of the week. Store in a big sealed container in the fridge.
ingredients: Cooked protein pasta (leftover from Monday, or cook fresh)
steps: If cooking fresh pasta, cook per package, then rinse under cold water until fully cooled.
Slice cucumber, halve cherry tomatoes, open the chicken strips.
Toss everything together in a large bowl: pasta, chicken, tomatoes, cucumber, feta.
Dress with Greek dressing — start with 3 tbsp, toss, taste, add more as needed.
Season with salt and pepper.
Transfer to a sealed container. Refrigerate. Done — this is your grab-and-go for the week.

meals.title: JUST Egg & Veggie Frittata
meals.note: Grab the Cold Pasta Salad for lunch today. The frittata is dinner — slices keep well for 2 days, so save some for Sunday.
ingredients: JUST Eggs (from QFC) — about ¾ carton
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Dice all veggies.
Heat a splash of olive oil in an oven-safe skillet (cast iron works great) over medium heat.
Sauté onion 2 min, then add peppers and zucchini. Cook ~5 min until softened. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder.
Pour JUST Eggs over the veggies evenly. Let cook on stovetop 2 min until edges just start to set.
Transfer to oven. Bake 12-15 min until the center is set (not jiggly).
Let cool 5 min, then slice into wedges.

meals.title: TJ's Frozen Indian Entrée + Brown Rice
meals.note: Go for Palak Paneer (higher protein from paneer) or Dal Makhani (great fiber + protein from lentils). Both are excellent.
ingredients: TJ's frozen Indian entrée (Palak Paneer or Dal Makhani)
steps: Microwave the frozen entrée per package directions (~3-4 min). Give it a stir halfway through.
Microwave frozen rice per package (~3 min).
Plate rice, spoon entrée on top.
Done. Seriously.

meals.title: Lemon Pepper Chicken Bowl
meals.note: Keeping it lighter and lower-carb today with riced cauliflower instead of rice. If you're hungry, add a side of Greek yogurt.
steps: Heat lemon pepper chicken per package (stovetop or microwave).
Microwave riced cauliflower per package (~3-4 min).
Plate: cauliflower base, chicken on top.
Drizzle a little olive oil over everything.
Optional squeeze of lemon to brighten it up.

meals.title: Cold Pasta Salad (Grab & Go)
meals.note: Nothing to do — just pull the pasta salad container out of the fridge. It was made Tuesday and is good through today. Add a Greek yogurt on the side.
steps: Open the fridge.
Take out the pasta salad container.
Eat. 😊

meals.title: Frittata Leftovers or Frozen Indian Entrée
meals.note: If you have frittata wedges left from Wednesday, those reheat great in a pan (2 min) or microwave (1 min). Otherwise, lean on your second frozen Indian entrée.
steps: Option A: Reheat frittata slices in a skillet over medium 1-2 min per side, or microwave 60 seconds.
Option B: Microwave frozen entrée ~4 min, microwave rice ~3 min, plate and serve.
Either way — easy Sunday. You earned it.
